roleDatadopeBullets: Built IOMETRICS SmartOps®, an AI platform that helps operations teams investigate incidents with a human always in the loop (Next.js · React · TypeScript · Python · FastAPI · PostgreSQL).
Core features of the operator console: redesigned events view (configurable columns, shareable alert URLs) and a demo mode for client presentations.
Reliable real-time updates over WebSockets: token refresh, reconnection, server-side pagination reconciliation and new-alert notifications.
Password and session hardening across frontend and backend: strength, expiry and history policies, account lockout, concurrent session control and SAML sign-in.
Backend & AI: automated alert investigation, ingestion contract validation and safe database migrations; contributions to AI agent features and data privacy safeguards.
Performance (list virtualization, load profiling), WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and testing with Playwright, Vitest and pytest; 110+ merged MRs with AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, Cursor).

Helped reshape the team's workflow for AI-assisted development: larger end-to-end tasks instead of small Jira tickets, bigger MRs with automated and agent-based reviews, and a rethink of cross-team sync.
